name: ESET Business Products
summary: ESET is a cybersecurity software vendor. The vendor publishes an End of Life policy page for business applications with two tables: 'Ongoing terminations' (applications scheduled for terminal EOL with End of Sale and End of Life dates) and 'Terminated applications' (applications already at EOL with End of Life dates). Coverage is sparse — many applications have 'Not available' or 'Not planned' dates. Day-precision dates are used where published.

notes: The ESET business EOL policy page lists applications in three categories: 'Applications at maintenance stage' (maintenance-only, not scheduled for EOL — excluded), 'Ongoing terminations' (scheduled for EOL with End of Sale and End of Life dates), and 'Terminated applications' (already at EOL with End of Life dates). Only applications with published day-precision dates are included. Many applications have 'Not available' or 'Not planned' dates and are excluded. The End of Sale date maps to eos and the End of Life date maps to eol (terminal support end). No GA dates are published for any application. Day-precision ISO dates are used directly. This contribution represents the subset of ESET business products with published EOL dates.
